protocol.audit: all acknowledged writes at all three ingress nodes after Split Done and route convergence
protocol.primary_window: first min(60, floor(shortest Split Done duration in stage300)) seconds after cross-group Split request, common to all four runs
secondary_windows: whole run success / actual total stage elapsed
protocol.isolation: exclusive VM150, firmware runtime masks across entire ABBA; original unit state restored afterward
protocol.no_latency_claim: No guarantee under arbitrary failures; two trials per arm do not establish statistical significance.
